newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ABN AMRO to expand in eastern Europe.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO to expand in eastern Europe.

text.p: Dutch bank ABN AMRO NV said on Monday it would probably expand its business in Western Europe through organic growth and that it would aim for acquisitions in Eastern Europe.
ABN AMRO said it was on the lookout for acquisitions in Romania, the Czech Republic and Poland and Hungary. In Hungary it already acquired Magyar Hitel Bank in 1996.
"Hungary was our first step in Eastern Europe," Michael J. Drabbe, member of the board of directors, told a news conference on the 1996 annual report.
Drabbe said that it was not likely that ABN AMRO would be able to find an acquisition in Western Europe that met the requirements it demanded from any partner.
The bank would thus focus on organic growth for its existing business in this market, he said.
